I +91 9620249371 « +91 7737110137 § github.com/nareshpatel1015

WORK EXPERIENCE THB (Technology|Health Care|Big Data Analytics) | Senior Backend Engineer 07/2022 – Present/ ◦ Designed and developed an enterprise Slot Management and Appointment Booking platform for India’s largest hospital chains (Max Healthcare, Medanta), processing 6M+ appointments annually across 15+ locations with unified real-time slot management, replacing legacy infrastructure and reducing administrative overhead by 40%.

Implemented bidirectional integration on on-premises servers to synchronize data between THB’s platform, hospital HIS systems, and third-party vendors, achieving zero data loss across all connected systems.

Designed and implemented a centralized concurrency management layer that reduced development overhead and became a widely adopted utility across the engineering team.

Designed and developed a flexible fallback mechanism for on-premises servers to process consumer events, replacing multiple special-case cron jobs with a single generalized solution.

Designed developed RESTful API ecosystem with consistent patterns clear documentation using NestJS and TypeScript, implementing request validation middleware, error handling patterns, and API versioning strategies that reduced integration time for new hospital partners from 2 weeks to 3 days.

Kindlife | Founding Engineer 02/2021 – 07/2022 ◦ Designed automated order shipment system improving delivery processing from 3 days to minutes, scaling from 150

orders/day to real-time processing using PHP, MySQL, and AWS SQS.

Redesigned payment flow architecture resulting in 20% increase in online payment completion rates and built reward point system increasing user engagement by 40%.

Designed and developed product and brand tagging integration between commerce website and community platform, enabling seamless content cross-referencing.

Collaborated with founders on order status feature requirements and developed state machine for order lifecycle management, improving order tracking transparency.

Twango Social Network Pvt. Ltd. | Backend Developer 10/2019 – 01/2021 ◦ Optimized API response times from 600ms to 300ms and designed asynchronous processing mechanisms, improving

system performance and implementing automated training REST APIs for sales teams.

Led technology migration from PHP to Node.js and built internal automation systems for lead distribution and customer support operations.

SKILLS ◦ Backend Technologies | NestJS | Node.js | TypeScript | Java | Python | Express | PHP | Laravel ◦ Databases & Storage | PostgreSQL | MySQL | MongoDB | DynamoDB | Redis | Database Design ◦ AWS & Cloud | Lambda | ECS | CloudWatch | CodeBuild | CodeCommit | SQS | SES | S3 | Athena ◦ Architecture & Development | RESTful APIs | System Integration | CI/CD | Jenkins | Docker | Git | Agile ◦ AI/ML Technologies | LangChain | RAG | Vector DB | Supabase | ComfyUI | Flux | AI Model Fine-tuning

PROJECTS Blaze - AI-Powered Development Automation | Personal Project | Open Source Present ◦ Built Blaze — an open-source AI-powered Slack bot that automates end-to-end code changes by fetching Jira/Linear tickets, generating implementation plans via LLM, and opening reviewed PRs from a Docker sandbox with zero manual setup.

Hubby.ai - AI Relationship Assistant | Personal Project 2024 ◦ Built AI chatbot backend using Node.js, LangChain, RAG architecture, vector database, and Supabase integration for

relationship guidance and communication assistance.

Wingardium - AI Image Generation | Personal Project 2024 ◦ Fine-tuned image models on Flux and created AI workflows using ComfyUI for customized visual outputs, generating

production-grade product images deployed across live e-commerce platforms (Zepto, Calae).

EDUCATION Indian Institute of Information Technology Kota | 07/2014 – 05/2018

B.Tech

AI-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT & AUTOMATION ◦ Building intelligent automation agents and AI-powered workflows that eliminate repetitive tasks and accelerate devel- opment cycles, with expertise in LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and agentic systems using Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.

sections.text:
PROJECTS Blaze - AI-Powered Development Automation | Personal Project | Open Source Present ◦ Built Blaze — an open-source AI-powered Slack bot that automates end-to-end code changes by fetching Jira/Linear tickets, generating implementation plans via LLM, and opening reviewed PRs from a Docker sandbox with zero manual setup.
Hubby.ai - AI Relationship Assistant | Personal Project 2024 ◦ Built AI chatbot backend using Node.js, LangChain, RAG architecture, vector database, and Supabase integration for
relationship guidance and communication assistance.
Wingardium - AI Image Generation | Personal Project 2024 ◦ Fine-tuned image models on Flux and created AI workflows using ComfyUI for customized visual outputs, generating
production-grade product images deployed across live e-commerce platforms (Zepto, Calae).
